'''Virtual Happiness''' was a popular [[Virtual reality|virtual-reality]] vacation business on the capital [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], one of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] several establishments specializing in [[Sim-vacation|sim-voyages]].

In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], after the establishment had gone out of business, [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] criminals [[Granta Omega]], [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], and the [[Slams|Slam gang]], under the pretense of starting a business, moved into the structure, effectively using it as a hideout, or ''safe house'', in preparation for a major operation against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The contingent of criminals planned a diversionary heist of a Republic account funded with [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]] called the [[All Planets Relief Fund]], reserved for worlds in peril who successfully petitioned for aid, to avoid the standard quagmire of bureaucratic red tape that often delayed planetary relief in urgent situations. The heist was set to take place at the conclusion of the inaugural ceremony for the new fund, when the vertex was transferred to a [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]] vault.

The diversion was meant to draw away the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], which was the true target of their machinations—the assassination of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and as many targeted [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] as their army of programmed [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker droids]] (hundreds strong) could kill. Although their plot was ultimately foiled by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]], who were able to contain the murderous [[Attack on the Senate Building|attack]], 45 Senators, [[Senatorial aide]]s and guards (plus a civilian, former [[Romin]] tyrant [[Roy Teda]]), yet lost their lives before it was over.<ref name="JQ:TFP">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>
